newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Travel, Coastal International form JV.
newsitem.headline: China Travel, Coastal International form JV.

text.p: Coastal International Holdings Ltd said on Monday it formed a joint venture with China Travel Service (Holdings) Hong Kong Ltd and China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Ltd to develop projects in China.

The company, CTS-Coastal Investment Ltd, would engage mainly in the investment, development, management and operation of transportation-related projects in China, including toll roads and bridges, Coast International said in a statement.

CTS-Coastal International had signed a conditional acquisition agreement to buy a 60 percent stake in a toll road project, the Tianjin North Section Highway of the Beijing-Shanghai Expressway, it said.
The total investment cost of the project is 1.36 billion yuan, of which CTS-Coastal International would invest some 800 million yuan, it said.
